subject: Glitches in renderDataFrame in Shiny - some subsets work, some don't

messages.author: 55dc2f7e6217e588
messages.subject: Glitches in renderDataFrame in Shiny - some subsets work, some don't
parts:
I'm currently testing a small Shiny app using subsetting in DataFrames to be rendered: 

While I get the correct results in other tabs from the same tabset (using the exact same filters / subset criteria)
and while it show in one branch of multiple if clauses, it doesn't show on other branches, even though it seems correct:

ui.Code:

  mainPanel(
      tabsetPanel(type = "tabs", 
                  tabPanel("Plot", plotOutput("plot")), 
                  tabPanel("Summary", verbatimTextOutput("summary")), 
                  tabPanel("Data Details", dataTableOutput("details"))
      )
    )


Server Code:

 # Generate an HTML table view of the data

  output$details <- renderDataTable({
    if (input$relplot == "age_dist" && as.numeric(input$gender) == 3) 
    {
      data.frame(subset(age.profile.df, age >= input$age_range[1] & age <= input$age_range[2]))
    }
    if (input$relplot == "age_dist" && as.numeric(input$gender) < 3) 
    {
      data.frame(subset(age.profile.df, gender == input$gender & (age >= input$age_range[1] & age <= input$age_range[2])))
    }
    if (input$relplot == "lerb_dist" && input$gender == 3) 
    {
      subset(doc.profile.df, doc_count >= input$lct_range[1] & doc_count <= input$lct_range[2])
    }    
    if (input$relplot == "lerb_dist" && input$gender < 3) 
    {
      subset(doc.profile.df, gender == input$gender & doc_count >= input$lct_range[1] & doc_count <= input$lct_range[2])
    }    
    if (input$relplot == "hm_age_lerb" && input$gender == 3) 
    {
      subset(age.doc.profile.df, age >= input$age_range[1] & age <= input$age_range[2] & doc_count >= input$lct_range[1] & doc_count <= input$lct_range[2])
    }
    if (input$relplot == "hm_age_lerb" && input$gender < 3) 
    {
      data.frame(subset(age.doc.profile.df, gender == input$gender & age >= input$age_range[1] & age <= input$age_range[2] & doc_count >= input$lct_range[1] & doc_count <= input$lct_range[2]))
    }
  })


=> Subsetting works in Plot & Summary and in the last "if-branch" of Data Details but not in the others. I have confirmed the parameters to be set as per the if statements and also that the subsetting catches data. However put together in the above fragment it doesn't seem to work.

Any fresh eyes or hints are welcome.

Best
-Tom

parts:
This seems like more of an R question.  I am not a super seasoned R developer but I suspect that the problem you have is that he reason the last one works is because by default a code block will return the result of the last statement.  I wonder if your code would work if you assigned something like:  returnDF <- 

And then have returnDF at the very bottom of the code block below the last if statement.   You will need to define returnDF outside the first if and you may need to assign the value by using the <<- operator.   The more elegant answer would be to pull the ifs into a separate function and explicitly using the return() function.  

Again this is a total guess on my part.

it was a lot easier - simply using "if & elseif" instead of only ifs solved the issue.
Everything works as intended now... Thanks for your help!

Cheers
-Tom
